sources.label: Wikipedia, "Krios and Kronos"
sources.quote: Originally designated HD 240430 is a Sun-like star in appearance, but it seems to have eaten its own planets, for which it is given the nickname Kronos, after the Greek god and the leader of the first generation of Titans.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.1 solar radii and 1.06 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,960 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
